```{r}

subjects <- tibble::tribble(
  ~who             , ~cfb_athlete_id , ~gsis_id     ,
```

```{r}
#| label: data
```

## 1. Introduction

- Kyle Allen and Shane Buechele are the Buffalo Bills' backup quarterbacks
  as the 2026 season begins.
- This post, the site's first, follows both from their high-school
  recruiting profiles through their college rosters to their NFL entry, to
  see how two quarterbacks with different starting points reached the same
  NFL role.

## 2. Data

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
*Data as of the `data-latest` release, retrieved 2026-08-27. Both players'
NFL careers are ongoing, so the NFL record runs through the 2026 roster and
may extend further.*
:::

### Four records follow each player from high school to the NFL

Each record below is matched on the player's own id, never on his name, so
the trajectory cannot borrow a different player with the same name.

```{r}
#| label: records-table
tibble::tribble(
  ~record                , ~what_it_holds                                                                                                                      , ~source                        ,
  "Recruiting profile"   , "Star grade (2 to 5), a 0 to 1 composite rating, and the national rank among all recruits in the high-school class"                   , "CFBD recruiting"              ,
  "College roster season" , "A season in which the player appears on a college team's roster, whether or not he played"                                       , "CFBD rosters"                 ,
  "NFL roster season"    , "A season in which the player appears on an NFL club's roster, whatever his role"                                                  , "nflverse rosters"             ,
  "Draft record"         , "A pick in the NFL draft; an NFL player with no draft record entered the league undrafted"                                         , "CFBD and nflverse draft picks"
) |>
  kable(
    col.names = c("Record", "What it holds", "Source"),
    caption = "The four records behind each player's trajectory."
  )
```

## 3. Results

### Kyle Allen arrived as the far higher-rated recruit

```{r}
#| label: recruiting-nums
#| include: false
# The recruiting id is an untrusted namespace (decision 0013); this direct
# filter is QA-verified for these two named players (the pin below checks the
# recruit name), not a general-purpose join.
recruits <- tbl(con, "recruiting") |>
  filter(playerId %in% !!subjects$cfb_athlete_id) |>
  select(
    playerId,
    recruit_name,
    hs_class,
    committed_to,
    recruit_position,
    stars,
    rating,
    national_rank
  ) |>
  collect() |>
  inner_join(subjects, by = c("playerId" = "cfb_athlete_id"))
rget <- function(who, col) recruits[[col]][recruits$who == who]
```

Kyle Allen was a `r rget("Kyle Allen", "stars")`-star recruit ranked
`r fmt(rget("Kyle Allen", "national_rank"))` nationally in the class of
`r rget("Kyle Allen", "hs_class")`, while Shane Buechele was a
`r rget("Shane Buechele", "stars")`-star ranked
`r fmt(rget("Shane Buechele", "national_rank"))` in the class of
`r rget("Shane Buechele", "hs_class")`, and the table sets the two profiles
side by side.

```{r}
#| label: recruiting-origins
style_labels <- c(
  PRO = "Pro-style quarterback",
  DUAL = "Dual-threat quarterback"
)
recruits |>
  arrange(desc(stars)) |>
  transmute(
    Player = who,
    `High-school class` = hs_class,
    `Committed to` = committed_to,
    `Recruited as` = unname(style_labels[recruit_position]),
    Stars = stars,
    `Composite rating` = sprintf("%.4f", rating),
    `National rank` = national_rank
  ) |>
  kable(
    caption = "High-school recruiting profiles. A lower national rank is better; rank 1 is the top recruit in the class."
  )
```

### Both quarterbacks left their first school and finished college at a second

```{r}
#| label: build-spine
#| include: false
# Assemble the college->NFL spine (one row per player-season) with a
# data-backed draft status, keyed on athlete/gsis ids (decision 0015). Reads the
# published parquet on its cleaned schema (decision 0018); draft status comes
# from nfl_draft_picks.
spine <- player_trajectory(
  subjects,
  roster = tbl(con, "roster"),
  nfl_rosters = tbl(con, "nfl_rosters"),
  nfl_draft_picks = tbl(con, "nfl_draft_picks")
)

# Guard the spine before display enrichment: non-null who/team/stage, stage in
# {College, NFL}, complete logical `drafted` (decision 0005).
contract_player_trajectory(spine)

# Team brand colors + logos (display only, decision 0008). College teams come
# from teams.parquet; NFL clubs from nflverse, since teams.parquet is college
# only. `logo` columns are ESPN/CFBD image URLs.
#
# Pick the logo variant with better contrast on each tile from its luminance:
# dark tiles get the light ("dark-background") logo, light tiles the standard
# one. CFBD's columns are logo_light (/logos/, for light bg) and logo_dark
# (/logos-dark/, for dark bg) — counter-intuitive, so key off luminance, not name.
rel_lum <- function(hex) {
  ok <- grepl("^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$", hex)
  out <- rep(NA_real_, length(hex))
  if (any(ok)) {
    m <- grDevices::col2rgb(hex[ok]) / 255
    lin <- ifelse(m <= 0.03928, m / 12.92, ((m + 0.055) / 1.055)^2.4)
    out[ok] <- 0.2126 * lin[1, ] + 0.7152 * lin[2, ] + 0.0722 * lin[3, ]
  }
  out
}
college_meta <- tbl(con, "teams") |>
  select(team, color, logo_light, logo_dark) |>
  collect() |>
  transmute(
    team = team,
    name = team,
    color,
    logo = if_else(
      !is.na(rel_lum(color)) & rel_lum(color) < 0.5,
      logo_dark,
      logo_light
    )
  )
nfl_meta <- nflreadr::load_teams(current = FALSE) |>
  transmute(
    team = team_abbr,
    name = team_name,
    color = team_color,
    logo = team_logo_espn
  )
team_lookup <- bind_rows(college_meta, nfl_meta) |>
  distinct(team, .keep_all = TRUE)

spine <- spine |>
  left_join(team_lookup, by = "team") |>
  mutate(tooltip = paste0(name, " · ", season))

# Fail loudly at authoring time, before the post is frozen (decision 0015).
stopifnot(
  nrow(spine) > 0,
  all(subjects$who %in% spine$who),
  !anyNA(spine$color),
  !anyNA(spine$logo),
  # The caption's "neither was drafted" claim, backed by the draft-pick table:
  # fail the build if either player ever appears among drafted picks.
  !any(spine$drafted)
)
```

```{r}
#| label: path-nums
#| include: false
# One row per player summarising the college and NFL legs of the spine,
# bounded at 2026 so later refreshes cannot move the pinned counts.
path <- spine |>
  filter(season <= 2026) |>
  arrange(who, season)
college_leg <- path |>
  filter(stage == "College") |>
  group_by(who) |>
  summarise(
    college_seasons = n_distinct(season),
    n_schools = n_distinct(team),
    first_school = first(name),
    last_school = last(name),
    transfer_after = max(season[team == first(team)]),
    last_college = max(season),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
nfl_leg <- path |>
  filter(stage == "NFL") |>
  group_by(who) |>
  summarise(
    rookie_season = min(season),
    first_club = first(name),
    nfl_seasons = n_distinct(season),
    n_clubs = n_distinct(team),
    club_2026 = name[season == 2026][1],
    .groups = "drop"
  )
path_summary <- subjects |>
  left_join(college_leg, by = "who") |>
  left_join(nfl_leg, by = "who")
pget <- function(who, col) path_summary[[col]][path_summary$who == who]
```

Each tile in the figure is one roster season colored and badged by its
team, and the arrows mark the two moments the argument turns on: the
transfer after `r pget("Kyle Allen", "transfer_after")` for Allen and after
`r pget("Shane Buechele", "transfer_after")` for Buechele, and the step
from college to the NFL with no draft pick in between.

```{r}
#| label: fig-timeline
#| fig-height: 5
tl <- spine |>
  mutate(who = factor(who, levels = c("Kyle Allen", "Shane Buechele")))
# row 1 = Allen (annotated below), row 2 = Buechele (annotated above);
# arrows point at the boundary between the two tiles where each move happens
a_xfer <- pget("Kyle Allen", "transfer_after") + 0.5
a_entry <- pget("Kyle Allen", "rookie_season") - 0.5
b_xfer <- pget("Shane Buechele", "transfer_after") + 0.5
b_entry <- pget("Shane Buechele", "rookie_season") - 0.5
xfer_label <- function(who) {
  sprintf(
    "Transfer after %d:\n%s to %s",
    pget(who, "transfer_after"),
    pget(who, "first_school"),
    pget(who, "last_school")
  )
}
entry_label <- function(who) {
  sprintf(
    "Undrafted NFL entry:\n%s, %d",
    pget(who, "first_club"),
    pget(who, "rookie_season")
  )
}
p <- ggplot(tl, aes(x = season, y = who)) +
  geom_tile_interactive(
    aes(fill = color, tooltip = tooltip, data_id = paste(who, season)),
    color = "white",
    height = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_from_path(aes(path = logo), height = 0.09) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = a_xfer + 0.3,
    y = 0.25,
    label = xfer_label("Kyle Allen"),
    size = 4,
    hjust = 1
  ) +
  annotate(
    "curve",
    x = a_xfer + 0.1,
    y = 0.42,
    xend = a_xfer,
    yend = 0.64,
    curvature = 0.2,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")),
    linewidth = 0.7,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = a_entry - 0.3,
    y = 0.25,
    label = entry_label("Kyle Allen"),
    size = 4,
    hjust = 0
  ) +
  annotate(
    "curve",
    x = a_entry - 0.1,
    y = 0.42,
    xend = a_entry,
    yend = 0.64,
    curvature = -0.2,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")),
    linewidth = 0.7,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = b_xfer + 0.3,
    y = 2.78,
    label = xfer_label("Shane Buechele"),
    size = 4,
    hjust = 1
  ) +
  annotate(
    "curve",
    x = b_xfer + 0.1,
    y = 2.6,
    xend = b_xfer,
    yend = 2.36,
    curvature = -0.2,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")),
    linewidth = 0.7,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = b_entry - 0.3,
    y = 2.78,
    label = entry_label("Shane Buechele"),
    size = 4,
    hjust = 0
  ) +
  annotate(
    "curve",
    x = b_entry - 0.1,
    y = 2.6,
    xend = b_entry,
    yend = 2.36,
    curvature = 0.2,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")),
    linewidth = 0.7,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(tl$season), max(tl$season), 1)) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = expansion(add = 0.95)) +
  labs(
    title = "Two schools each, then the NFL without a draft pick",
    subtitle = "Team by roster season, college through the NFL",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Read each row left to right; a change of tile color is a change of team. Hover any tile for the team and season."
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl(base_size = 14) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), legend.position = "none")
girafe(ggobj = p, width_svg = 12, height_svg = 5)
```

### Neither quarterback was drafted, and both stayed on NFL rosters into 2026 with the Bills

```{r}
#| label: nfl-nums
#| include: false
# Draft status checked in both draft sources, each on its own id namespace:
# CFBD picks on the college athlete id, nflverse picks on the NFL player id.
cfbd_draft_rows <- vapply(
  as.integer(subjects$cfb_athlete_id),
  \(id) {
    tbl(con, "picks") |>
      filter(collegeAthleteId == !!id) |>
      count() |>
      pull(n)
  },
  numeric(1)
)
nflverse_draft_rows <- vapply(
  subjects$gsis_id,
  \(id) {
    tbl(con, "nfl_draft_picks") |>
      filter(gsis_id == !!id) |>
      count() |>
      pull(n)
  },
  numeric(1)
)
path_summary$draft_rows <- cfbd_draft_rows + nflverse_draft_rows
nfl_positions <- tbl(con, "nfl_rosters") |>
  filter(gsis_id %in% !!subjects$gsis_id) |>
  distinct(gsis_id, position) |>
  collect()
```

Both draft records return zero rows for either player, yet Allen has
`r pget("Kyle Allen", "nfl_seasons")` NFL roster seasons across
`r pget("Kyle Allen", "n_clubs")` clubs and Buechele
`r pget("Shane Buechele", "nfl_seasons")` across
`r pget("Shane Buechele", "n_clubs")`, and the table lists each player's
entry and where his NFL record stands in 2026.

```{r}
#| label: undrafted-entry
path_summary |>
  arrange(who) |>
  transmute(
    Player = who,
    `Last college team` = last_school,
    `NFL entry` = sprintf("%s, %d", first_club, rookie_season),
    `Draft records found` = draft_rows,
    `NFL roster seasons` = nfl_seasons,
    `NFL clubs` = n_clubs,
    `2026 club` = club_2026
  ) |>
  kable(
    caption = "NFL entry and NFL record through 2026. Draft records found counts matching rows in both the CFBD and nflverse draft-pick tables."
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: nfl-pin
stopifnot(
  # The "neither was drafted" claim, backed by both draft-pick tables and the
  # spine's own draft status: fail the build if either player ever appears.
  all(path_summary$draft_rows == 0),
  !any(spine$drafted),
  all(nfl_positions$position == "QB"),
  pget("Kyle Allen", "first_club") == "Carolina Panthers",
  pget("Kyle Allen", "rookie_season") == 2018,
  pget("Kyle Allen", "nfl_seasons") == 9,
  pget("Kyle Allen", "n_clubs") == 6,
  pget("Shane Buechele", "first_club") == "Kansas City Chiefs",
  pget("Shane Buechele", "rookie_season") == 2021,
  pget("Shane Buechele", "nfl_seasons") == 6,
  pget("Shane Buechele", "n_clubs") == 2,
  all(path_summary$club_2026 == "Buffalo Bills"),
  # an NFL roster season in every season from entry through 2026
  all(path_summary$nfl_seasons == 2026 - path_summary$rookie_season + 1)
)
```

## 4. Summary

The Bills' two backup quarterbacks started far apart and converged. Kyle
Allen was a `r rget("Kyle Allen", "stars")`-star recruit ranked
`r fmt(rget("Kyle Allen", "national_rank"))` nationally and Shane
Buechele a `r rget("Shane Buechele", "stars")`-star ranked
`r fmt(rget("Shane Buechele", "national_rank"))`. Each then spent his
college career at two schools, Allen at
`r pget("Kyle Allen", "first_school")` and
`r pget("Kyle Allen", "last_school")`, Buechele at
`r pget("Shane Buechele", "first_school")` and
`r pget("Shane Buechele", "last_school")`, and each went from his final
college season straight to an NFL roster with no draft record in either
draft source. Through 2026, Allen has `r pget("Kyle Allen", "nfl_seasons")`
NFL roster seasons with `r pget("Kyle Allen", "n_clubs")` clubs and
Buechele `r pget("Shane Buechele", "nfl_seasons")` with
`r pget("Shane Buechele", "n_clubs")`, and both are on the
`r pget("Kyle Allen", "club_2026")` roster in 2026.

## 5. Discussion

::: {.callout-important}
Neither recruiting profile led to a draft pick, a top-ten national rank included.

- Allen's national rank of `r fmt(rget("Kyle Allen", "national_rank"))`
  and Buechele's `r fmt(rget("Shane Buechele", "national_rank"))` ended
  at the same NFL entry point: undrafted, then on a roster the following
  season.
- Two careers are a case study, not a rate; how often highly rated
  quarterback recruits go undrafted is a question for the full population.
:::

::: {.callout-important}
Going undrafted did not end either NFL career early.

- Both players have appeared on an NFL roster in every season since
  entering the league, Allen with `r pget("Kyle Allen", "n_clubs")` clubs
  in `r pget("Kyle Allen", "nfl_seasons")` seasons and Buechele with
  `r pget("Shane Buechele", "n_clubs")` in
  `r pget("Shane Buechele", "nfl_seasons")`.
:::

Several caveats bound these facts.

- A roster season records presence on a roster, not playing time,
  starts, or statistics, so the trajectory says where each player was,
  not how much he played.
- Both NFL careers are ongoing, so the NFL record is incomplete by
  construction.
- The recruiting rating is a single composite grade from the high-school
  class year and does not reflect later development.
